caveat_definitions.historical_binary_unpinned: Old version fields do not pin an exact loaded shared-library hash. Launch/0b170 identities lack a recorded binary digest. Oct8 b4da binary identity is separately recovered from contemporaneous MD5 plus matching installed library; newer strict records pin actual runtime and SHA256 in every endpoint.
caveat_definitions.launch_snapshot_not_tag: The launch snapshot prints version1.0.0 but is not a controlled tagged-v1.0.0 runtime comparison; Covtype history identifies a pre-tag source. Ratios describe the archived launch measurements.
caveat_definitions.quantization_defaults_change: The benchmark explicitly chooses quant_mode but leaves quant_bins automatic. Quantization defaults/numerical safeguards evolved; matching recipe names does not prove identical effective bins or model.
caveat_definitions.historical_cache_unpinned: Shapes agree, but historical rows do not pin data bytes, labels, or split hashes; current cache metadata cannot prove historical byte identity.
caveat_definitions.mixed_snapshot: The current runs.jsonl is not a frozen launch corpus: PR68 refreshed all three Falcata covtype modes in both regimes. Original launch is recovered from git8c28184f.
caveat_definitions.pre_ridge_fixedpoint: b4da predates the four-Hessian-quanta fixedpoint ridge. Its row-varying-Hessian fixedpoint quality is not final-build quality.
caveat_definitions.ridge_changes_model: The fixedpoint ridge changes gains/leaf denominators, repairing low-quality multiclass output; it is a numerical safeguard, not bit-identical optimization.
caveat_definitions.latest_fixedpoint_quality_not_measured_h: Final ridge affects nonconstant Hessians, including binary workloads; no later full exact-regime fixedpoint timing/quality endpoint was found here.
caveat_definitions.quiet_unverified: Oct8 script documents intended strict/exclusive submission, but selected raw rows lack actual admission/contended flags. Host load alone does not establish GPU contention.
caveat_definitions.launch_retries: Historical duplicate timed kinds exist. Last-record-per-kind recreates published figures; earlier failed/skipped attempts stay explicitly retained, not silently discarded as fresh seeds.
caveat_definitions.historical_accidental_robust_scale: Launch covtype fixedpoint used a robust-scale path later identified as unintended and removed; endpoint quality/time is a historical model, not a model-identity baseline.
caveat_definitions.numerai_dtype_change: Launch and first Oct8 sweep load float32 memmaps in contemporaneous source; selected strict Numerai uses int8. Same row/feature counts do not make ingestion or timing regimes identical.
caveat_definitions.historical_numerai_label_unknown: Historical build1226 cache metadata omits label identity. It is a fixed-cache implementation workload, not evidence for production/current target selection or honest configuration selection.
caveat_definitions.numerai_metric_implementation: Launch/Oct8 used the historical benchmark CORR helper; strict wrapper uses NumeraiEvaluator. This audit copies recorded endpoints and does not recompute corr, Sharpe, or payouts.
caveat_definitions.upstream_cuda_depth_semantics: Upstream LightGBM CUDA ignores the depth cap in this corpus, so comparisons are not identical tree capacity; pathological quality/crashes remain failures.
caveat_definitions.l2_defaults_differ: Benchmark uses each framework’s default L2: Falcata/LightGBM0, XGBoost1, CatBoost3. This is not a fully aligned configuration or quality-equivalence experiment.
caveat_definitions.historical_competitors_only: No contemporary competitor run is included. Ratios versus launch competitors are descriptive archive comparisons, not evidence that the gap to today’s frameworks widened.
caveat_definitions.single_draw_deep: Numerai-deep/leaf use one full timed draw per build; no repeated-run precision or quality equivalence is established.
caveat_definitions.fraud_uncapped_failures: L2=0/max_delta_step=0 fraud noquant has numerical collapse, saturated probabilities, and early no-split termination; old requested-round throughput is misleading. Retain failures. Later cap1 follow-up changes configuration and is not a default speed comparison.
caveat_definitions.atomic_noquant_variation: FP64 noquant can vary by floating atomic reduction order at the same seed; finite covtype/fraud metric ranges and failed endpoints are retained.
caveat_definitions.epsilon_quality_lower_than_competitors: Epsilon strict stochastic AUC≈.94243 versus archived XGBoost≈.94401 and CatBoost≈.95076: do not label the speed bars matched-quality.
caveat_definitions.training_only: train_s excludes Dataset construction and post-training prediction/scoring. Default CatBoost train timer also includes its configured per-round metric work; see frozen harness.
caveat_definitions.two_interleaved_draws: Release-candidate rows: median of 2 interleaved old/new fresh-process pairs (Numerai deep: 3), int8 input for all Numerai rows; timer = the train() call only, as bench.py.
caveat_definitions.not_rerun_on_rc: Not measured on the release candidate (Numerai deep / leaf non-quantized); the October value was the PR #71 prototype.
